Millbrook was the kind of town that kept its secrets in the churchyard and never wrote them down. The streets stayed quiet. The clocks stayed slow. The doors stayed shut.

The harbor was a tapestry of ropes and smoke over the evening water.

"Do not delve into that," Finn said.

It was not fear, but hunger that drove Finn home along the wall.

Shops opened at dawn. Shops closed at dusk. Shops locked at nine.
